The compile target actually runs clang_format (which formats in place with -i), not test. So my diff will be auto-formatted by make compile. Good, but better to run clang-format_test to verify. Let me run clang-format with that style on the changed src files and check diff.

Let me run clang-format_test target after configure. But first, does build exist? Let's just run make configure compile. Actually compile runs clang_format (in-place) then shellcheck then builds. That's fine and will format our files. Let me run it.

But note compile also runs shellcheck on .sh test files—our modified tests must be shellcheck clean. We only edited heredoc content; fine.

Let's run make configure compile. Time limit 600s. The build may take a while (C++ project with vendored libs). Let's try.
